程序包 org.bukkit.util

类 BlockIterator

java.lang.Object
org.bukkit.util.BlockIterator
所有已实现的接口:
Iterator<Block>
public class BlockIterator extends Object implements Iterator<Block>
This class performs ray tracing and iterates along blocks on a line 此类执行射线追踪，并沿一条直线上的方块进行迭代

    • BlockIterator

      public BlockIterator(World world, Vector start, Vector direction, double yOffset, int maxDistance)
      Constructs the BlockIterator 构造 BlockIterator
      参数:
      world - The world to use for tracing 用于追踪的世界
      start - A Vector giving the initial location for the trace 给出追踪起始位置的 Vector
      direction - A Vector pointing in the direction for the trace 指向追踪方向的 Vector
      yOffset - The trace begins vertically offset from the start vector 追踪从起始向量垂直偏移此值处开始 by this value
      maxDistance - This is the maximum distance in blocks for the 这是追踪的最大方块距离。将此值设置得高于 140 可能导致未加载区块的问题。值为 0 表示无限制 trace. Setting this value above 140 may lead to problems with unloaded chunks. A value of 0 indicates no limit
